changes.historical_text: While this card is face-up on the field, battle positions of all face-up Insect-Type monsters on your opponent's side of the field are changed into Attack Position. Each time this card destroys an Insect-Type monster as a result of battle, increase the ATK of this card by 500 points.
changes.summary: Era trigger timing, not a text erratum: the GOAT script gains the 500 ATK from a single mandatory trigger on EVENT_BATTLED whose condition checks that the battled monster was destroyed and is an Insect, i.e. after the battle concludes. The modern script splits this into a continuous effect on EVENT_BATTLED that records a flag when the battle target is an Insect and a TRIGGER_F on EVENT_BATTLE_DESTROYING that reads the flag, so the boost triggers at the destruction itself. The GOAT operation also registers the boost without the modern c:IsRelateToEffect(e) guard. Chronology is unresolved - nothing in the packet dates the timing change.

review.notes: Upstream annotates the goat variant 'Activation timing', matching the EVENT_BATTLED/EVENT_BATTLE_DESTROYING difference. The position-changing effect is identical in both scripts (EFFECT_SET_POSITION over the opponent's Insect monsters, value POS_FACEUP_ATTACK), so v2's dropped 'face-up' qualifier has no script correlate. Text lineage is cosmetic: v0 (IOC-080, 2004-03-01) -> v1 (DR2-EN081, 2005-10-20) is 'As long as this card remains face-up' -> 'While this card is face-up' and 'in battle' -> 'as a result of battle', and predates the baseline; v1 -> v2 (OP07-EN015, 2018-04-13) is the PSCT rewrite to 'If this card destroys an Insect monster by battle: This card gains 500 ATK.' The ATK boost reset (RESETS_STANDARD_DISABLE) is the same in both.
